documented_adjustment_semantics: INDEC metadata states that fractions and radios 00 in Entre Ríos and Misiones are adjustment surfaces to the river median line and do not carry census data.
known_limitations: The national layer integrates DPE cartography and adjusts it to IGN provincial limits.
INDEC documents possible deformation and exceptional transfer of surface when adapting radios to provincial limits.
